//: Raw server-sent-event streams replayed by a loopback server for the SDK stream-tolerance tests. A scenario's chunks are written and flushed one at a time, or, when chunkBytes is set, their UTF-8 bytes are written that many at a time (splitsMultiByte: the suites check that a write boundary really falls inside a multi-byte character); close 'abrupt' destroys the connection without ending the response. 'probes' name a delivered event (by type and occurrence) and a field it carried that the SDK has no property for: the outcome records true or false for whether the field survived, and null when the SDK delivered no such event. 'expect' holds the pinned outcome per language SDK; 'measuredAgainst' records the SDKs the pins were measured against, and any SDK or generator upgrade is a reason to re-measure.

measuredAgainst.note: SDKs generated from the API specification of that release; the done event carries inferenceBalanceCentsChargedMilli. Re-measure after any SDK or generator upgrade.
